description: Demolition of existing dwelling and redevelopment constructing a detached two storey dwelling with basement level and habitable roof space; landscaping; boundary treatment; bin storage
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, C, D and E in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.

No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.

The windows, openings and rooflights on the side elevations of the proposed development shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level, and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, no construction works shall take place, including demolition, until a Construction Method Statement and Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. It shall provide for:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>a)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of the development&nbsp;</p><p>b)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;&nbsp;</p><p>c)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp;</p><p>d)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;&nbsp;</p><p>e)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction; and&nbsp;</p><p>f)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works.&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout the construction period.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost as part of the development hereby approved&nbsp;with
an Arboricultural Impact Assessment and Tree Constraints Plan. Details of those to be retained, together with measures for their protection in the course of the development, shall also be submitted and approved, and carried out in accordance with such approval, prior to any demolition or any other site works, and retained until the development is completed.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as bat boxes, bird boxes, hibernacula, insect hotels, and habitat enhancement measures such as removal of cherry laurel, native planting and pond creation, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (other than demolition works), a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p><br></p><p>a) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space:</p><p>i) for fire appliances to be positioned on</p><p>ii) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</p><p>b) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures</p><p>c) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</p><p>d) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users</p><p>e) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p>f) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not be commenced (other than works of demolition) until the following details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Compensatory Flood Storage and relationship with Flood Maps</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Disposal of Surface Water</p><p>c) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Disposal of Sewage</p><p>d) <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Details of Finished Floor Levels&nbsp;</p><p>e)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Permeable paving</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and details and prior to the commencement of the relevant part of works, full details of proposed solar panels with elevation and section drawings showing the rooflights shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and details and prior to the commencement of the relevant part of works, full details of following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p><br></p><p>a) Full details, including specifications and dimensions, of Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHPs)</p><p>b) Noise Impact Assessment of the ASHP</p><p>c) Acoustic enclosures (where necessary)</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>No development shall take place (including vegetation/site clearance) until a Precautionary Working Method Statement (PWMS) for bats, nesting birds, Great Crested Newts, other amphibians, reptiles, and mammals such as badgers and hedgehogs has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The PWMS should include, but may not be limited to;</p><p><br></p><p>i.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A toolbox talk covering the ecology of and legislation which protects species which may be present on site, to be delivered to construction personnel by the Ecological Clerk of Works (ECoW);</p><p>ii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A plan showing areas of sensitivity and exclusion zones;</p><p>iii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of where and how waste and/or construction materials will be stored;</p><p>iv.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of mitigation measures required for protected species, such as herptile fencing;</p><p>v.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Details of which construction tasks pose a risk to protected species, and will therefore be supervised by the ECoW;</p><p>vi.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Measures for supervised vegetation clearance (e.g., phased, directional cut);</p><p>vii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Precautionary measures for the removal of a pond feature;</p><p>viii.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Guidance on sensitive roof strip techniques; and</p><p>ix.<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Procedures to be followed if a protected species is discovered.</p><p><br></p><p>The approved PWMS shall be implemented in full according to the specified timescales, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, full details of authority the location of a secure and sheltered cycle store, including the dimensions and external finish of the store shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation of the development and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the construction of the development hereby permitted shall not proceed above the damp proof course level until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of:</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Permeable Paving</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Rooflights</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Side gates</p><p><br></p><p>have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, full details of the bin store shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The bin stores shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage area as shown on the approved plans.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Basement Waterproofing, Drainage & Flood Mitigation Strategy; Bat Emergence and Re-entry Survey; DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT & PRE APPLICATION RESPONSE IN SUPPORT OF THE FULL APPLICATION AT 19 Bellfield Avenue August 2026 Rev C; Heritage Impact Assessment (10137A); Lighting Assessment (94473 Rev A); Preliminary Ecological Appraisal and Preliminary Roost Assessment; Subterranean Method Statement Rev 1; SD-11 Rev 1; SL-10 Rev 1;  SL-20 Rev 1; SL-30 Rev 1; SL-40 Rev 1; SL-50 Rev 1; Sustainable Drainage Statement (2250046 Rev P02); 19 Bellfield Avenue HA3 6ST – Building Survey & Feasibility Study; 24014 PA 01.01; 24014 PA 01.01 Rev A; 24014 PA 01.02; 24014 PA 01.03; 24014 PA 01.04; 24014 PA 02.01 Rev A; 24014-PL- 02.01 Rev C;  24014 PA 02.01 Rev C; 24014-PL- 02.02 Rev C; 24014- PL- 02.03 Rev C; 24014 PL 03.01 Rev C; 24014- PL- 04.01 Rev C.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the following:</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) and details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site.</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken.</p><p>d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works.</p>

<p>No external lighting shall be installed on the dwelling hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details</p>
